definition.title: What "sunrise" means
items: Sunrise is when the sun's upper edge touches the horizon. Atmospheric refraction makes it visible while it is still below the horizon.
Times assume an open sea horizon at sea level, the same basis KASI uses.
Mountains or buildings to the east delay the moment you actually see the sun by a few minutes.

elevation.title: Higher means earlier
items: From higher ground the horizon sits lower, so the sun appears earlier: roughly 1–2 minutes per 100 m.
Seongsan Ilchulbong (182 m) faces the open sea, so its summit sees the sun about 2 minutes earlier.
High peaks such as Cheonwangbong and Taebaeksan gain 8–9 minutes on paper, less when distant ridges block the horizon.

why.title: Why some spots are first
items: The sun rises in the east, so Dokdo, the easternmost point, is first.
In winter the sun rises in the southeast, so Ganjeolgot in the south beats Homigot; in summer Homigot is earlier.
Waemok Village in Dangjin faces east, so it is known as a rare west-coast sunrise spot.

tips.title: Before you go
items: The sky starts brightening about 30 minutes before sunrise. Arrive early.
Early January mornings are often below freezing. Bring gloves, heat packs and a warm coat.
Popular spots close roads or fill parking lots during New Year events. Check local government notices.
Cloud forecasts appear about 9 days before and change daily. Check again the night before.

items.q: What time is sunrise on January 1, 2027?
items.a: At sea level: Dokdo about 7:26, Ganjeolgot 7:31, Haeundae and Homigot 7:32, Jeongdongjin 7:39 and Seoul 7:47 a.m.

items.q: Where does the sun rise first in Korea?
items.a: Dokdo. On the winter mainland, Ganjeolgot and Daewangam Park in Ulsan are earliest. High summits see it earlier by their height.

It uses the same kind of astronomical calculation and usually matches within a minute. All 7 spots KASI announced for Jan 1, 2026 matched to the minute. KASI announces New Year sunrise times every December.

items.q: Can I see the sunrise if it is cloudy?
items.a: Low cloud near the eastern horizon can delay or hide the sun. Cloud cover here is for the whole sky, so treat it as a guide.

items.q: Where can I see the sunrise in Seoul?
items.a: Sunrise in central Seoul is about 7:47 a.m. Higher places with an open view east, such as Namsan or Achasan, show it a little earlier and above the buildings.
